nodes.description: Public constant token symbol string 'U3D'.
Public constant token name string 'unity3d'.
Public constant decimals value (1).
Private constant total supply (12800000) returned by totalSupply().
Private mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Private nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by approve, allowance and transferFrom.
Constructor Unity3d() that assigns the entire total supply to msg.sender without checks.
Constant view function returning the fixed __totalSupply.
Constant view function returning __balanceOf[_addr].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to when value > 0 and <= sender balance.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from _from to _to; guarantees allowance and balance coverage.
Sets __allowances[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no zero-allowance precondition.
Constant view function returning __allowances[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner/spender key and initial supply receiver.
Unchecked balance arithmetic inside transfer: __balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value and __balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked balance arithmetic inside transferFrom: __balanceOf[_from] -= _value and __balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked allowance decrement inside transferFrom: __allowances[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Unconditional allowance overwrite in approve: __allowances[msg.sender][_spender] = _value (classic approve race condition).
Parameter _addr of balanceOf, the account whose balance is read.
Parameter _to of transfer, recipient of the tokens.
Parameter _value of transfer, amount of tokens moved.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, allowance owner and debit account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, credit account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount of tokens moved and allowance spent.
Parameter _spender of approve, allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve, new allowance amount.
Parameter _owner of allowance, token owner queried.
Parameter _spender of allowance, spender queried.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the full __totalSupply into __balanceOf[msg.sender].
msg.sender controls who receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
totalSupply reads the constant __totalSupply.
balanceOf returns __balanceOf[_addr].
transfer internally invokes balanceOf(msg.sender) as its guard condition.
transfer debits and credits accounts determined by the untrusted caller msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes __balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transfer performs the unchecked balance arithmetic operation.
The transfer arithmetic mutates __balanceOf without overflow/underflow protection.
transfer recipient _to is supplied by the caller.
transfer amount _value is supplied by the caller.
User-supplied _to indexes the balance credit in the unchecked arithmetic.
User-supplied _value feeds the unchecked balance subtraction/addition.
transferFrom spends the allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom reads and decreases __allowances[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes __balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance arithmetic.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom balance updates mutate __balanceOf without overflow/underflow protection.
transferFrom allowance decrement mutates __allowances without overflow/underflow protection.
transferFrom debit account _from is supplied by the caller.
transferFrom credit account _to is supplied by the caller.
transferFrom amount _value is supplied by the caller.
User-supplied _from indexes the unchecked balance debit and balance check.
User-supplied _to indexes the unchecked balance credit.
User-supplied _value feeds the unchecked balance arithmetic.
User-supplied _from indexes the allowance key used in the unchecked decrement.
User-supplied _value feeds the unchecked allowance decrement.
approve writes __allowances[msg.sender][_spender].
approve keys the allowance by the untrusted caller msg.sender.
approve performs the unconditional allowance overwrite operation.
Allowance is overwritten without a zero-value precondition, enabling the approve/transferFrom race.
approve spender _spender is supplied by the caller.
approve amount _value is supplied by the caller.
User-supplied _spender is written into the allowance mapping without validation.
User-supplied _value overwrites any previous allowance without validation.
allowance returns __allowances[_owner][_spender].
Parameter _addr selects the balance mapping key in balanceOf.
Parameter _owner selects the allowance mapping key in allowance.
Parameter _spender selects the inner allowance mapping key in allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: _addr is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf and carries no independent semantics.
_to is only used as the recipient index of __balanceOf inside transfer.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic performed by transfer.
_from is only used to index __allowances and __balanceOf inside transferFrom.
_to is only used as the credit account of __balanceOf inside transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic and allowance decrement in transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the raw amount written into the allowance mapping with no precondition.
_owner is only used as the outer lookup key inside allowance.
_spender is only used as the inner lookup key inside allowance.
